AT_OrbitalBeamStrike.description.english: Call down a power beam from a derelict orbital satellite onto the chosen location. The beam ignites everything in a wide radius and inflicts massive flame damage. The archotech thumb's uplink takes time to recharge between strikes.

AT_ArchotechThumb.description.english: An installed archotech thumb. Despite its modest size it conceals an archotech subpersona, an array of forbidden communications hardware, and a direct uplink to a derelict orbital weapon platform. With a thought, the wearer can call down a column of solar fire from the heavens. Like other archotech parts, it looks and feels like natural flesh, is harder to damage than plasteel, and repairs itself over time.

An artificial thumb built by an archotech. Inside its tiny shell sits a subpersona AI, a bank of forbidden uplink antennae, and a permanent handshake with a long-forgotten orbital weapon platform. Once installed, the wearer can call down a power beam from orbit at will. Like other archotech parts, it is harder to damage than plasteel and repairs itself over time.
